task.title: To manually register the Add-In
task.shortdesc: The add-ins are now available in the Excel ribbon. You may need to restart Excel

step.cmd: Start Excel and select File > Options to display the Excel Options dialog.
Click Add-Ins, select COM Add-ins from the Manage list, and click Go.
Select the Apttus X-Author Designer and X-Author for Excel check boxes and click OK.

result.p: The add-ins are now available in the Excel ribbon. You may need to restart Excel for the tabs to display as expected.
